notes.title: Love Colors patch 1.0.1 - Achievements fix
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Pixel lovers,

We've checked your feedback regarding some achievements that haven't been unlocking properly. They should now work as smoothly as your brush![/h2]

Grab the list of changes here:

[b]Precise Painter[/b]
[list]
[*] Changing colors doesn't break the counter for this achievement to unlock
[/list][b]Tool Master[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the pixel counter
[/list][b]Achievements related to finishing a collection[/b]
[list]
[*] All achievements unlocked by finishing a collection should now work properly
[/list]

And if you haven't grabbed your copy of Love Colors, check out the 40% launch discount, while it lasts!
